inactive_tab.info: This feature helps reduce cart abandonment by dynamically updating the browser tab title when visitors switch away from your store. Personalize your message with [emojis](https://getemoji.com/) to catch their attention and encourage them to return. Please note that previewing this feature is not supported within the theme editor. To see it in action, please visit your live store and switch to another tab.
